[Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=42), according to some theologians, is a living entity in and of itself. Diabolic dragons, these scholars argue, are just extensions of the plane, living creatures that break off from Hell to enact its will. Whether this is true or whether diabolical dragons are simply the reborn souls of dragons sent to Hell, the fact remains that these dragons are powerful, cunning, and tyrannical. Every diabolic dragon's goal is to further Hell's will, though how this happens can vary. Regardless of their goals, these dragons always approach newcomers with an unsettling calmness. **[Recall Knowledge - Dragon](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35)): DC 42 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 40 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 37 [Ancient Diabolic Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2940) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 114 **Perception** +33; [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet, smoke vision **Languages** [Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115), [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20), [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +33, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +38, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +34, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +36, [Hell Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +33, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +34, [Legal Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +35, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +35, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +33, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +33 **Str** +10 **Dex** +5 **Con** +8 **Int** +5 **Wis** +7 **Cha** +8 **Smoke Vision** Smoke doesn't impair the dragon's vision; they ignore the [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) condition from smoke. --- **AC** 44 **Fort** +36 **Ref** +32 **Will** +32 +2 status to all saves vs. [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579) **HP** 390 **Immunities** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) **Weaknesses** [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) 15 **[Frightful Presence](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=64)** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental 90 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), DC 40)
**Hell's Sting** ([divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)) **Trigger** The dragon is critically hit with a melee attack; **Effect** The dragon channels the rancor of [Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=42) back through the body of their foe, overwhelming it with an infernal assault on the mind. The triggering creature takes 10d6 mental damage with a DC 42 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save. [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) creatures use an outcome one degree of success worse than they roll on their saving throw.
**[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 70 feet, fly 180 feet **Melee** jaws +38 ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 4d12+18 piercing plus 2d6 fire **Melee** claws +38 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 4d8+18 piercing plus 2d6 fire and [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Melee** tail +36 ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 4d8+18 bludgeoning plus 2d6 fire and [Improved Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Divine Innate Spells** DC 40, attack +32 - **Cantrips (10th)** [Ignition](/Spells.aspx?ID=1565) - **7th** [Interplanar Teleport](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) (at will; self only) - **8th** [Summon Fiend](/Spells.aspx?ID=323) ([phistophilus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2909) only; at will) - **9th** [Divine Immolation](/Spells.aspx?ID=1496) (at will), [Falling Stars](/Spells.aspx?ID=1521) (fire only), [Wall of Fire](/Spells.aspx?ID=362) (at will) **Diabolic Fire** Any fire damage that a diabolic dragon deals, including fire damage from spells, is imbued with the unholy power of Hell to scorch the spirit as well. A creature takes [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage instead of fire damage if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM). A diabolic dragon is immune to the diabolic fire of other diabolic dragons, the fire from [_divine immolation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1496), and similar effects. **Draconic Frenzy** The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order. **Draconic Momentum** The dragon recharges their Hellfire Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike. **Hellfire Breath** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)) The dragon unleashes a blast of infernal fire that deals 21d6 fire damage in a 50-foot cone (DC 42 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The dragon can't use Hellfire Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
